query:
SELECT count(*) AS "count!",
               GREATEST(0, extract(epoch FROM
                   (COALESCE(min(created), now()) + make_interval(secs => $2)) - now()))::bigint
                   AS "retry_after_secs!"
          FROM kb_join_requests
         WHERE requesting_profile_id = $1
           AND created > now() - make_interval(secs => $2)
